title: Brownian motion with drift conditioned to have restricted $L^2$-norm
summary: We study the long-time behaviour of Brownian motion with drift under a rare-event conditioning of the quadratic additive functional $Z_T=\int_0^T W_s^2ds$, where $(W_t)_{t\geq 0}$ is a Brownian motion with drift $μ$. More precisely, we consider the conditional law of $W$ given the event $Z_T\le θT$, as $T\to\infty$, allowing the drift $μ$ to depend on $T$. We derive sharp, uniform small-deviation asymptotics for $Z_T$, including the exact prefactor, and use them to show that the conditioned process converges weakly to an Ornstein--Uhlenbeck process.
